Destinations

Four islands. One standard.

We only work where we can be on the ground. That means local teams, houses we know by heart, and advice that does not come from a search engine.

How we choose

A destination earns its place.

A place has to offer more than a beach and an airport. We look for a genuine sense of place, a team we trust and houses that are worth the journey — then we spend a season learning the details before we list a single property.

01

Spain · 38°54′N 1°25′E

Ibiza

The original. Still the one.

Ibiza is where Invenio began, and where the portfolio is deepest: whitewashed houses in the hills, long tables under the pines, and a coastline that rewards people who know it.

Discover Ibiza →
02

Spain · 38°43′N 1°27′E

Formentera

Slow, salt-bleached, unrepeatable.

A short ferry from Ibiza, and a different century. Formentera is flat, luminous and best explored by bicycle — with long lunches, shallow water and nowhere to be.

Discover Formentera →
03

Greece · 37°24′N 25°20′E

Mykonos

Whitewash, wind and a very long lunch.

Cycladic white, a blue that looks edited, and a social calendar that runs late. Mykonos is the Aegean at its most polished — and, away from the crowds, still full of quiet corners.

Discover Mykonos →
04

Indonesia · 8°39′S 115°08′E

Bali

The other side of the world, same standard.

Rice fields, temple gates and a garden that grows while you watch. Bali is our furthest destination and our most requested long-haul one — a different climate, the same way of looking after a house.

Discover Bali →
